caption: The drawing depicts a marionette puppet suspended by several black strings, set against a plain beige background. The puppet has a large head with exaggerated facial features, including wide eyes, a prominent nose, and a black mustache and goatee. It wears a light-colored, loosely wrapped turban on its head. The puppet is dressed in a multi-colored outfit, featuring a long robe with pink, purple, and red vertical stripes and patches outlined in yellow and green squares. The robe also includes blue and grayish hues and is fastened or detailed with dark buttons. The puppet’s hands are carved and brownish, with one holding a cylindrical blue and gray object. The figure has black shoes with visible laces. The marionette's overall appearance is accentuated by its vibrant clothing and the contrast of the detailed facial features with the simpler background. The artist’s signature, "Ruth G. Abrams," appears in the lower right corner of the drawing.
title: David and Goliath Marionette
